programme.title: The Missouri Breaks
programme.desc: In their only screen pairing, legends Marlon Brando and Jack Nicholson set the screen ablaze as a bounty hunter and his horse-thieving prey in director Arthur Penn's intense and startlingly realistic western classic! Harry Dean Stanton co-stars.

programme.title: Sam Whiskey
programme.desc: Welcome to America's Wild - and very wacky - West! Burt Reynolds, Clint Walker, Ossie Davis and Angie Dickinson star in this tongue-in-cheek tale of love, lust and larceny as an amiable con-artist is hire by a sexy widow to break into the U.S. Mint.

programme.title: The Scalphunters
programme.desc: Sydney Pollack directs Burt Lancaster, Shelley Winters, Ossie Davis and Telly Savalas in this lively and ribald western about a frontier-wise fur trapper who loses his pelts to a band of Kiowas in exchange for a slave he doesn't want.

programme.title: From Noon Till Three
programme.desc: Charles Bronson plays Graham Dorsey, a bank robber who, through a series of twists and turns finds himself the object of national adoration. A beautiful widow, Amanda Starbuck (Jill Ireland) is responsible for creating this myth.

programme.title: The White Buffalo
programme.desc: Charles Bronson and Will Sampson star as Wild Bill Hickok and Chief Crazy Horse in this one-of-a-kind western that finds both western legends braving the snowy wilderness in search of the demon that haunts them both, the fabled White Buffalo!

programme.title: Cast A Long Shadow
programme.desc: Audie Murphy plays a troubled saddle tramp with a penchant for drinking. After inheriting a ranch, he is led back into the arms of an old flame.

programme.title: Terror In A Texas Town
programme.desc: In this compelling and imaginative western, a peace-loving Swedish seaman is forced to take on an entire frontier town when he discovers a ruthless oil prospector has been forcing farmers to sell their land...or pay for it with their lives.

programme.title: Day Of The Outlaw
programme.desc: In this stark, unconventional and powerful western, a ruthless rancher (Robert Ryan) must find a way to save the town of Bitters, Wyoming, its citizenry, and his own soul when a gang of outlaws rides into town. Burl Ives and Tina Louise also star.

programme.title: Man From Del Rio
programme.desc: When a Mexican gunslinger (Anthony Quinn) rids a town of several notorious gunfighters, he is named the sheriff, but must win over the rest of the residents who are yet to warm to his hard-hitting ways. Katy Jurado and Peter Whitney co-star.

programme.title: Along Came Jones
programme.desc: Gary Cooper gives a marvelous, tongue-in-cheek performance as a fumble-fingered cowpoke who is mistaken for a notorious bandit and almost gets killed by both sides of the law...all while managing to capture the attention of Loretta Young.

programme.title: Man Of The West
programme.desc: Screen legend Gary Cooper demonstrates why he will always be remembered as one of the most authentic stars of the screen. Capable yet vulnerable, Cooper's portrayal of a former outlaw whose past returns to haunt him ranks among his very best.

programme.title: The Way West
programme.desc: Screen icons Kirk Douglas, Robert Mitchum and Richard Widmark star in this in this sumptuous epic as pioneers who travel the treacherous Oregon trail.

programme.title: The Wonderful Country
programme.desc: In this action-packed western, ex-pat Martin Brady (Robert Mitchum) travels to Texas to broker an arms deal for Mexican Governor Castro (Pedro Armendariz). But things get complicated when the the guns he was returning to Mexico are stolen.

programme.title: The Big Country
programme.desc: From legendary director William Wyler comes this bold, epic western, the story of a ship's captain (Gregory Peck) who ventures west to find a hotbed of jealousy, hatred and dangerous rivalries. Burl Ives won a Supporting Actor Oscar® for his role.

programme.title: Billy Two Hats
programme.desc: Archie (Gregory Peck) and his partner, Billy (Desi Arnaz, Jr.) are bandits by trade, staging daring robberies throughout the American frontier. But when their latest heist takes a deadly turn, they are pursued by a ruthless marshal (Jack Warden).

programme.title: The Hunting Party (1971)
programme.desc: To cattle baron Brandt Ruger (Gene Hackman), his stunning wife (Candice Bergen) is just one of his possessions. So when a notorious bandit kidnaps her, an enraged Ruger organizes a posse to recover his property dead or alive in the searing western!

programme.title: Lawman
programme.desc: In Michael Winner's unique take on the western, a sheriff (Burt Lancaster) is determined to bring to justice a rancher (Lee J. Cobb) and his hands who accidentally killed an old man during a drunken spree. Robert Ryan and Robert Duvall co-star.

programme.title: The Unforgiven
programme.desc: John Huston directs Audrey Hepburn in this thrilling, romantic western about a woman who becomes the target of lawless racism and brutality when it is discovered that she was born to the Kiowa tribe but secretly adopted by a white frontier family.

programme.title: The Kentuckian
programme.desc: Eli Wakefield (Burt Lancaster) and his son are Kentucky adventurers longing for life on the Texas frontier. They learn, however, that their greatest challenge lies not in the uncharted wilderness, but in the people they meet along the way.

programme.title: Vera Cruz
programme.desc: In this epic Western, two shady mercenaries (Gary Cooper, Burt Lancaster) in Mexico during the 1866 revolution are hired to escort a Countess and her gold to the Mexican army in Vera Cruz and find themselves at odds with the army... and each other!

programme.title: Valdez Is Coming
programme.desc: In this rousing Western, when a greedy rancher causes the death of an innocent man, former sheriff Bob Valdez (Burt Lancaster) orders him to provide financial support for the widow. But when he refuses, Valdez vows to exact justice at any cost!

programme.title: Support Your Local Sheriff!
programme.desc: James Garner stars in this rollicking western spoof that has him taking on the job of a frontier town sheriff who must fend off villains (led by Walter Brennen) from every direction...all without breaking a sweat or dirtying his shiny black boots!

programme.title: Support Your Local Gunfighter
programme.desc: James Garner is back in the saddle again as hustler Latigo Smith whose latest con is passing off cowhand Jug (Jack Elam) as the dreaded gunman Swifty Morgan. But when the real Swifty shows up, the Wild West is going to get a whole lot wackier!

programme.title: Hang 'Em High
programme.desc: Mistaken for a rustler and a killer, Jed Cooper is hanged on the spot by crooked lawman Captain Wilson. But as Wilson and his gang flee the scene, there's one important detail they've overlooked…Cooper is still alive! Saved by a sheriff, Cooper takes on the job of deputy marshal to bring justice to the Oklahoma territory…and to the nine men who "done him wrong."

programme.title: A Fistful Of Dollars
programme.desc: The Man With No Name (Clint Eastwood) receives offers from two gangs terrorizing a small town and accepts both, setting in motion a plan to destroy the criminals in a series of brilliantly orchestrated setups, showdowns and deadly confrontations.

programme.title: For A Few Dollars More
programme.desc: Clint Eastwood returns as the "Man With No Name," who teams up with equally lethal Colonel Mortimer (Lee Van Cleef) in pursuit of a sadistic killer and his band of desperadoes in this non-stop action classic from legendary director Sergio Leone.

programme.title: The Good, The Bad And The Ugly
programme.desc: Clint Eastwood portrays the invincible "Man With No Name" in lethal pursuit of $200,000 in Confederate money alongside Lee Van Cleef and Eli Wallach in this renowned, influential and classic cinematic western directed by the great Sergio Leone.

programme.title: A Fistful Of Dynamite
programme.desc: The results are explosive when an Irish terrorist (James Coburn) with a dynamite obsession teams up with a Mexican peasant-turned- revolutionary (Rod Steiger) in this action-packed tale of power and politics. Directed by the legendary Sergio Leone.

programme.title: The Mercenary
programme.desc: Mercenary Sergei Kowalski (Franco Nero) joins up with a Mexican revolutionary Paco Roman (Tony Musante) to rob a silver mine and bring new order to Mexico by force! Jack Palance and Giovanna Ralli co-star in this brilliant spaghetti western.

programme.title: Bandera Bandits
programme.desc: A ruthless bandit and his beautiful young accomplice blaze a trail of crime and passion across old Mexico, with a determined sheriff hot in pursuit.

programme.title: The Glory Guys
programme.desc: When a peaceful mission to move the Sioux to reservations turns into an ambitious general's vicious vendetta, a captain and his cavalry recruits are led towards a bloody fate. Written by Sam Peckinpah and starring Tom Tryon and Harve Presnell.

programme.title: The Horse Soldiers
programme.desc: John Wayne teams with William Holden and director John Ford for this rousing tale of one of the most daring cavalry exploits in all of history.

programme.title: The Alamo
programme.desc: John Wayne produces, directs and stars in this retelling of the Alamo, a battle in which 185 men joined together against an army of 7,000. Filmed entirely in Texas, "The Alamo" is a visually stunning and historically accurate celebration of courage.

programme.title: Red River
programme.desc: John Wayne, Montgomery Clift and Walter Brennan give stellar performances in Howard Hawks' epic masterpiece as a self-made cattle baron (Wayne) and his adopted son (Clift) risk everything to drive their herd across the treacherous Chisholm Trail.

programme.title: Michael Cimino's Heaven's Gate
programme.desc: This lavish, epic western retells the true story of Wyoming's infamous Johnson County War, a brutal, late 19th century conflict during which wealthy cattlemen, backed by the U.S. government, hired mercenaries to murder 125 immigrant settlers.
